description: Interloop Limited started in Faisalabad in 1992 with ten knitting machines and today describes itself as a vertically integrated manufacturer of hosiery, denim, knitted apparel and seamless activewear. It employs 37,000 people, with operations in Pakistan, Sri Lanka and China, and supplies some of the world's leading brands and retailers. The company describes itself as the largest listed apparel company on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
headOffice: 1 KM, Khurrianwala–Jaranwala Road, Khurrianwala, Faisalabad, Pakistan
